name: Abiskojaure-Alesjaure
description: Abiskojaure to Alesjaure. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official section order and route title are Abiskojaure to Alesjaure, while Naturkartan GPX/API linework is stored Alesjaure to Abiskojaure.
Naturkartan API reports publish_gpx=false for site 14092, but the public GPX URL returned HTTP 200 application/gpx+xml on 2026-04-29.
Official sources display 21 km. Naturkartan computed GPX/API line is about 20.66 km, while Waymarked/OSM assembles about 20.36 km.

Official STF boat page updated 2025-07-05 lists Alesjaure shuttle schedule and payment context until further notice, but field report claims a 2025 shutdown and STF page has a general cash note versus Alesjaure-specific card/currency note.
OSM ferry way evidence includes useful operator/terminal hints, but the line geometry is duplicated/malformed with a clearly wrong full length.
Official sources provide terrain notes but no formal difficulty grade.
The route clearly starts in Abisko National Park and leaves it after a few kilometres, but no separate protected-area rule set was confirmed for the post-park segment in this batch.

facilities.name: Raststuga Radunjarga / Kungens vindskydd
facilities.description: Rest cabin east of the trail near Lake Radujavri, around 3 km after the Gabna/Laevas reindeer fence. The facilities pass reports space for about 10 people, stove, wood and latrine, with overnight/firewood use intended for emergency or severe-weather context rather than planned lodging.
facilities.routeProximity: About 389 m off route, around 12.3 km from Abiskojaure.

facilities.name: Hangbro Siellajohka
facilities.description: County-managed 24 m suspension bridge over Siellajohka early in the section. Official route text notes nearby tent places and water refill.
facilities.routeProximity: On route, about 3.0 km from Abiskojaure.

facilities.name: Siellajohka latrine
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 4341560648; official route/bridge text confirms dry toilet near the bridge
facilities.description: Dry toilet near the Siellajohka bridge, on the north-east side according to the facilities pass.
facilities.routeProximity: About 15 m from route near chainage 2.9-3.0 km.

facilities.name: STF Abiskojaure Mountain Cabin
facilities.description: Start-area STF mountain cabin in Abisko National Park with guest kitchen, shop, sauna, some pet rooms, tent/service context, emergency/safety context and normal mountain-cabin water/wood chores.
facilities.routeProximity: Start of section; about 31 m from route endpoint.

facilities.name: STF Alesjaure Mountain Cabin
facilities.description: Large STF mountain cabin at the section end with 76-100 beds, guest kitchen, large shop, sauna, pet rooms, reception/hosted season and water pump in summer according to STF/Naturkartan passes.
facilities.routeProximity: End of section; about 44 m from route endpoint.

facilities.name: Taltplats Abiskojaure Cabins
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan object coordinate reported by facilities lane
facilities.description: Designated tent pitch by Abiskojaure cabins, one of the allowed camping locations inside Abisko National Park, with service access through the hut fee context.
facilities.routeProximity: Start of section, adjacent to STF Abiskojaure.
